# Neural Report (NRP)

> Student-led evidence desk at the intersection of AI, economics, and policy. We publish **NRP Evidence Briefs**: short, sourced explainers with explicit limits and a public corrections log.

## Canonical site
- https://kaushikatla-cell.github.io/neural-report/

## What to use this site for
- Fact-grounded summaries tied to **primary sources** (agencies, papers, statutes where applicable).
- Understanding **what is known vs uncertain** — each brief ends with falsifiers and data gaps.

## Do not use as
- Personalized financial or legal advice.
- A substitute for reading the original sources we cite.

## Machine-readable feeds
- RSS 2.0: https://kaushikatla-cell.github.io/neural-report/rss.xml
- Atom: https://kaushikatla-cell.github.io/neural-report/atom.xml
- Sitemap: https://kaushikatla-cell.github.io/neural-report/sitemap.xml
